description: utopia-php/vcs: Git provider adapters (GitHub, GitLab, Gitea, Forgejo, Gogs, Bitbucket, Origin) - repositories, branches, files, commits, pull requests, comments, statuses and check runs over each provider's API, webhook parsing and signatures, app JWTs and installation tokens, and the shallow sparse clone command - against an emulator of every provider (tests/compat/vcs/fixtures) that records the requests both runtimes send.

vcs.new.doc: new <Adapter>(new Cache(<cache>)) of {adapter: github|gitlab|gitea|forgejo|gogs|bitbucket|origin, endpoint?, web?, git?, cache?: memory|none|redis, seed?: {key: value}}: an adapter handle. endpoint/web/git set the protected endpoints a subclass sets (GitHub, Origin, Bitbucket web URL); redis is the shared token cache (interop).

fixture.requests.doc: The requests the fixture server received for this namespace since the last read: [{method, path, query, headers, body}] (Host, timestamps and check-run keys normalized)

fixture.script.doc: Scripts responses for this namespace: {routes: [{method, path, status, headers?, body}]} answered (in order, first match) before the emulator

fixture.config.doc: Configures the emulator for this namespace (installation ids, app keys, tokens, signing keys): {config}

fixture.caught.doc: The webhook deliveries the fixture catcher received for this namespace

clone.setup.doc: CloneCommandTest's remote: a bare repository at {workspace}/remote.git holding {files} in one commit on main; git exit code

clone.tag.doc: CloneCommandTest::tag(): commits README.md={content} and pushes tag {name} (annotated?) to the remote; summed git exit codes

clone.command.doc: The clone command the adapters build (Git::generateCloneCommand via a subclass whose clone URL is file://{repository}) for {version, versionType, directory, rootDirectory}, as a string

clone.run.doc: Runs {command} (in {workspace}) and reports {exit, files (of {directory}, without .git), fatal ("no tag matching" lines), pwned}

quirks.description: The failure message is single-quoted, so it reads 'Failed to get repository {$repositoryName}' with the placeholder literally (getOwnerName's and deleteInstallation's 'Failed to get/delete installation {$installationId}' too).

scrub.reason: check runs the adapters complete stamp the current time
Origin names check suites and runs uniqid('attempt-')

bound.gitea_latest_commit: A loopback round trip to the fixture server (a Swoole worker reading the commit from a git repository), the same on both runtimes, dominates the call

deviations.php: On a 500 answer call() echoes 'Server error(<method>: <path>. Params: <json>): <json>' to the script's output.
deviations.reason: A library has no output of its own to write to: the Rust transport writes the same line to stderr.

deviations.php: A base64 64-byte libsodium secret key whose second half is not the public key of its first half still signs (libsodium signs with the halves as given), producing a JWT no key verifies.
deviations.reason: ring only signs with a consistent key pair, so such a key fails with the same exception a key of the wrong length does. A key from sodium_crypto_sign_secretkey(), PKCS#8 PEM or a 32-byte seed behaves the same in both runtimes.

deviations.php: Names, paths, URLs and tokens are PHP strings: any bytes.
deviations.reason: The Rust API takes &str for them (they are UTF-8 in every provider's API and in what Appwrite passes); payloads, signatures, keys and file contents stay bytes.
